title: Integrate European secondary-script compact bank
changes: Extend the compact catalog with root 6cb278 and four lookup bytes for initial secondary task IDs, retaining original ROM fallback elsewhere.
validation: Wine source windows and protected geometry establish the initial secondary IDs 363–366, selectors 0–3 and 1092 represented bytes without E124 overlap.
Windows GNU build PASS; Wine create/reuse PASS with 99 other resources and 58 prior banks unchanged.
Focused Wine test PASS for 1092 represented bytes and boundaries, original lookup reads and raw fallback, coherent rejection and five native count comparisons with full state and clock.
Wine 12-frame production startup PASS with 100 runtime identities; catalog reads were zero.
limitations: Primary constructor aliases, mutable state, other callers, ordinary use, Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified. No performance measurements.
